title: Have really good eyes to see the keypad.
text: Have really good eyes to see the keypad.. The microwave works fine that's not an issue, but reading the print on the buttons, you need the Hubble to figure out where beverage reheat is. Don't hit the wrong button to set a defrost time, because you'll be there all day trying to clear it. At first I blamed myself I do have problems with my eyes. But I have a "help desk" of four college-aged male children who after trying to figure it out for me, told me to buy another one and wait for it, they offered to pay for it. I think that says it all.
